sources.quote: Service and aftermarket parts are not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20
Service parts are governed by a separate document, STL-CSR-SP-01, which is not part of this excerpt.

findings.why: The only approval for Alluminio B and BR-220 (AP-0311) covers series production at TO1 for STL. The ASL excludes service and aftermarket parts, and no controlled record in the documents covers BR-220 as a service part. This is not a finding that the source is not approved. A person must confirm whether Alluminio B is approved for service-part BR-220, and for which receiving plant. The Stellantis service-part requirements (STL-CSR-SP-01) are not available.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The proposal uses billet already in stock. No certificate or tensile result is provided for that lot. Drawing Rev C requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01), and a 3.1 certificate with each lot. The grade, temper and yield of the stock billet cannot be checked. A person must supply the certificate for this lot. The email EML-SQ-2026-1105 says BR-220 is 6061-T6 with 240 MPa. That is Rev B data, superseded 2026-06-01, and it should not be used.
